# @stolyarovmn/dsh-ui-registry-aggregator 0.5.3

Stable promotion of `0.5.3-rc.1` for the current DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.4` target. Runtime code is unchanged from the validated RC.

## Included

- `Sources`, `Browse`, and `Updates` integrate through the official DSH `0.2.1` `plugins.tab` root slot;
- the old DOM polling bridge remains only as a compatibility fallback for `0.2.0-rc.2`;
- Browse artwork resolution supports the current DSH display resource contract `exports["./icon"]`;
- transient npm/unpkg/GitHub artwork failures are not cached as confirmed icon absence;
- package exports `"./icon": "./icon.svg"` and keeps `icon.svg` in the published files.

## Compatibility

- Declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`.
- Isolated install + Web boot smoke passes on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, and `0.2.1-rc.4`.
- Real DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` Chromium validation passed before promotion.

## Validation

- repository tests and JavaScript syntax checks pass;
- `npm pack --dry-run` passes;
- real RC4 browser smoke verified native Registry tabs, Browse results, SVG artwork for both plugins, the native Automation Tasks manager, and no plugin/runtime crash.

This version is the stable npm release and is intended to be published under dist-tag `latest`.
